reviewScope: Complete lexical candidate review of Scene2D data. Human-readable scene/entity/finish labels are authored product content and deferred for ownership; versions, IDs, aliases, tags, assets and structural values are technical.
limitations: Inventory only; scene data and localization resources remain unchanged.
The product/catalog owner must decide how translated entity labels and aliases are stored and exposed to scene accessibility/selection.
